notes: v1.1.110: The Login path now also carries the account's own device cookies, so a normal Login (not just a relogin) is trusted by Facebook and skips the Arkose puzzle - just password + 2FA. No-cookie accounts, which can't be trusted that way and are forced into Arkose, are now solved: the real browser needed for that puzzle is bundled with the app, so the solve works on every PC. Login progress is shown in plain words in each account's Status Detail (Logging in, Captcha solving, Captcha solved, Logged in) while the raw diagnostics stay in the log. The Warm Up account picker gets a Status filter (Live / Not Login / Suspended / Locked...) and a working right-click menu (Select Highlighted / Select All Shown / Deselect All Shown). Carries 1.1.109 (browser-less MetaMax-style relogin), 1.1.108, 1.1.107 and 1.1.106.
